description:
Because:

* FxA moves shared code from fxa-shared to Nx libs under libs/shared.
* fxa-auth-server must load only one copy of the Amplitude code.

This commit:

* Adds libs/shared/metrics/amplitude with the moved module and schema.
* Ports the 42 mocha cases to jest and deletes the mocha file.
* Moves the auth-server callers in log.js and metrics/amplitude.js.
* Makes fxa-shared/metrics/amplitude.ts a re-export shim with a spec.
* Adds ajv to the root package.json and the tsconfig.base.json path.

Closes FXA-14710
